diagnostics.limitation: The engine exposes ambiguous and conditional flags, not a semantic cancellation detector. These numbers describe caution on annotated cases, not cancellation accuracy.

timing.limitation: Node CPU batch timings; not browser or human-use timings. No cold network download occurred.

expected.note: Only participants change entrance; replacing the everyone instruction loses other roles.
Different object: bring syntax alone must not imply replacement.
New umbrella instruction does not replace bicycle storage.

limitations: 20 synthetic case pairs total; this report evaluates only its stated split. Labels are agent-authored, not a real-user study.
Similarity is retrieval, not entailment, contradiction detection, correctness or permission to replace.
The heldout author knows the labels; this is an implementer-reserved set, not an external blinded benchmark.
Node CPU is not the deployed browser WASM backend. Quantized model and pooling are the same, but browser parity is untested here.
Jaccard selection is a score-only diagnostic at fixed uncalibrated thresholds; ranking metrics are the cleaner baseline comparison.
